title: Port Calamity trailer (Blender), shot definitions for tools/trailer/export.mjs
note: Same shot format as tools/promo/storyboard.json (setup / warm / wait / preroll / cam keys, follow or a custom P.place set by the setup). Timing: dur (seconds) for the proof shots (P*); the trailer shots (S01..S19, PLAN.md section 4) carry k0 (first beat) and beats on the promo's measured beat grid, so cuts land on beats and the 19 shots are exactly 1440 frames at 24 fps. radius = metres of world kept around the camera path; look = preset in tools/trailer/blender/look.py (lookOverrides on top); shake, shutter, focus, waterY, pplR/pplMax (people kept) are optional. P.rec() in a setup records per-frame facts for Blender-native effects (blender/fx.py).

shots.move: drone crane up the SpeedScan tower to the stink lines, golden hour
shots.setup: g.game.sky.ask(17.6, 'clear', true); g.teleport(27, 110, 3.14);

shots.move: the Budget Line crossing the river trestle at sunrise, low from the bank, panning with the engine
shots.setup: g.stage(4); const tr = g.game.world.parts.find((p) => p.derail); let best = 1e9, hb = 6.8; for (let h = 6.6; h < 7.1; h += 0.004) { g.game.sky.ask(h, 'clear', true); g.step(1); const i = tr.info(); const d = Math.hypot(i.x - 345, i.z + 1440); if (d < best) { best = d; hb = h; } } g.game.sky.ask(hb, 'clear', true); g.step(1); P.train = { x: 0, y: 6, z: 0 }; P.each = () => { const i = tr.info(); P.train.x = i.x; P.train.z = i.z; }; P.each(); g.teleport(P.train.x + 50, P.train.z - 50, 0); console.log('promo: train hour ' + hb.toFixed(3) + ' at ' + JSON.stringify(tr.info())); const V = g.game.camera.position.constructor; P.cam0 = [356, 3.5, -1505]; P.place = (cam, s) => { const at = new V(P.train.x - 8, 6.5, P.train.z - 8); const p = new V(P.cam0[0] - 6 * s, P.cam0[1] + 0.8 * s, P.cam0[2] - 4 * s); g.game.view = { pos: p, target: at }; g.game.camera.fov = 40; g.game.camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); };

cam.custom: set by the setup: a fixed bank camera that pans with the lead car

shots.move: a bull moose stands in a misty snow lane, breath steaming; headlights come round the bend behind it; long lens, locked off
shots.setup: g.game.sky.ask(7.7, 'clear', true); const M = g.game.moose; let si = M.sites.findIndex((s) => /Anchor/.test(s.name) && Math.abs(s.z + 170) < 30); if (si < 0) si = M.sites.findIndex((s) => /Anchor/.test(s.name)); const s = M.sites[si]; M.forced = { si, t0: g.game.sky.hour * 60 - 36, bull: true, calf: false, stand: 120, side: 1 }; g.teleport(s.x, s.z, 0); g.step(1); P.site = { x: s.x, y: g.info().y, z: s.z }; g.teleport(s.x, s.z - 40, 0); P.rec = () => ({ site: [P.site.x, P.site.y, P.site.z, s.dx, s.dz] }); console.log('promo: moose site ' + s.name + ' ' + Math.round(s.x) + ',' + Math.round(s.z) + ' dir ' + s.dx.toFixed(2) + ',' + s.dz.toFixed(2));

shots.move: the chase begins: heat 5 on the Thruway, three cruisers, the helicopter low; camera ahead of the car looking back
shots.setup: g.stage(4); g.game.sky.ask(17.6, 'clear', true); const id = g.spawnVehicle('sports', -712, -1110, -3.114); g.drive(id); P.car = g.game.player.vehicle; g.setHeat(5); P.each = () => { g.setHeat(5); g.game.player.health = 100; };
shots.preroll: const HB = 34, HY = 11; const st = g.game.systems.find((s) => s.tag === 'police'); const H = st && st.heli; const c = P.car; const rig = [[10, -3.4], [17, 3.2], [26, -2.6]]; const cops = rig.map(([d, s]) => { const id = g.spawnVehicle('cruiser', c.x, c.z - 20, c.h); return g.game.vehicles.list.find((v) => v.id === id); }).filter(Boolean); P.each = () => { g.setHeat(5); g.game.player.health = 100; const fx = Math.sin(c.h), fz = Math.cos(c.h), rx = -fz, rz = fx; cops.forEach((v, k) => { const [d, s] = rig[k]; const w = s + Math.sin((P.t || 0) * 1.7 + k * 2) * 0.6; v.x = c.x - fx * d + rx * w; v.z = c.z - fz * d + rz * w; v.y = c.y; v.h = c.h + Math.sin((P.t || 0) * 1.7 + k * 2) * 0.03; v.vx = c.vx; v.vz = c.vz; v.driver = null; }); if (H) { H.present = true; H.x = c.x - fx * HB + rx * 7; H.z = c.z - fz * HB + rz * 7; H.y = c.y + HY; H.h = c.h; } }; P.rec = () => ({ cops: cops.map((v) => v.id) }); console.log('promo: ' + cops.length + ' cruisers rigged, heli ' + !!H);

shots.preroll: let n = 0; const me = g.game.player.vehicle; P.each = (dt) => { n += dt; if (n < 0.5) { me.vx = 0; me.vz = 0; } if (n > 0.5 && !P.go) { P.go = 1; for (const id of P.cars) { const v = g.game.vehicles.list.find((c) => c.id === id); if (v) v.driver = 'ai'; } } };

shots.move: first fireworks shells climb from the pier; the crowd watching, lit by the bursts
shots.setup: g.game.fireworks.mode = 'off'; g.game.sky.ask(21.3, 'clear', true); g.teleport(0, 560, 0); g.step(5); P.gnd = { x: 0, y: g.info().y, z: 0 }; for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) { const hs = (a) => { const x = Math.sin(k * 127.1 + a * 311.7) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x); }; g.game.people.spawn(-27 + k * 0.85 + hs(1) * 0.5, 553.5 + hs(2) * 3.2 + (k % 3) * 0.9, (hs(3) - 0.5) * 0.5); }
